page.content:
Nederlander house on 46th Street that has hosted Hamilton's Broadway run.

How Richard Rodgers Theatre connects

  • Work: Hamilton — Hamilton's Broadway run is at the Richard Rodgers Theatre.
  • Faction: The Nederlander Organization — The Nederlander Organization operates the Richard Rodgers Theatre.
  • Location: Broadway theatre district — The Richard Rodgers Theatre stands on 46th Street in the district.

What is Richard Rodgers Theatre?

The Richard Rodgers Theatre is the 46th Street house, now a Nederlander property, where Hamilton opened in 2015 and became the decade's defining Broadway booking.

Key threads lead to Hamilton, The Nederlander Organization and Broadway theatre district.
